item.title: Graph neural network prediction of temperature-dependent hydrogen diffusion and thermal conductivity tensors of tungsten containing helium bubbles and grain boundaries
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 S. Saito, M. I. Kobayashi, T. Kasahara
arXiv:2608.15609v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Helium bubbles and grain boundaries in tungsten plasma-facing components alter hydrogen-isotope transport and thermal conduction by orders of magnitude, yet evaluating these transport properties for a given microstructure requires hours of molecular dynamics (MD) per configuration. item.title: Long-range electrostatics in atomistic machine learning: a physical perspective
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Federico Grasselli, Kevin Rossi, Stefano de Gironcoli, Andrea Grisafi
arXiv:2602.11071v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The inclusion of long-range electrostatics in atomistic machine learning (ML) is receiving increasing attention for achieving quantum-mechanical accuracy in predicting a wide range of molecular and material properties. However, there is still no general prescription for how long-range physical effects should be incorporated into a model while preserving the well-established locality principles underlying most transferable ML representations. Here, we provide a physical perspective on this problem by discussing how distinct contributions to a system's electrostatics can be captured through different learning paradigms. Specifically, we distinguish between local charge models, which rely either on explicit charge-density decompositions or…

item.title: 面向带电点缺陷的多保真机器学习原子间势
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Xinwei Wang, Irea Mosquera-Lois, Aron Walsh
该研究指出，现有基础机器学习原子间势虽能较好描述体相材料能量、力和应力，但难以捕捉 Sb₂Se₃ 半导体中配位环境和电子数异常的带电缺陷物理。作者引入全局缺陷电荷嵌入以区分不同电荷态的成键特征，并采用多保真策略结合低成本半局域泛函数据与高质量杂化泛函能量和力。所得缺陷适用力场能够以远低于直接量子力学计算的成本预测稳定缺陷构型和缺陷热力学，并与第一性原理结果定量一致。

item.title: 基于机器学习原子间势的纳米晶硅声子热输运研究
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Houssem Rezgui, Catalina Coll Benejam, Clivia M. Sotomayor Torres, Miguel Pruneda
该工作发展了结合高斯近似势、多原子簇展开、晶格动力学和分子动力学的机器学习原子间势框架，用于研究体相与纳米晶硅中的声子热输运。作者在统一的 Phonopy/Phono3py 流程中由机器学习势提取谐性与非谐力常数，计算声子色散、寿命和晶格热导率，以提高复杂界面和晶界体系振动性质描述的一致性。对于纳米晶硅，非平衡分子动力学被用于直接量化晶界相关热边界阻抗和界面声子散射效应。

item.title: Generalizable foundation models for calorimetry via mixtures-of-experts and parameter efficient fine tuning
item.description:
📚 Machine Learning: Science and Technology
👤 Carlos Cardona-Giraldo, Cristiano Fanelli, James Giroux, Cole Granger, Benjamin Nachman and Gerald Sabin
Modern particle physics experiments face an increasing demand for high-fidelity detector simulation as luminosities rise and computational requirements approach the limits of available resources. Deep generative models have emerged as promising surrogates for traditional Monte Carlo simulation, with recent advances drawing inspiration from large language models (LLM) and next-token prediction paradigms. In this work, we introduce a generalizable foundation model (FM) for calorimetry built on next-token transformer backbones, designed to support modular adaptation across materials, particle species, and detector configurations. item.description:

👤 Cibrán López, David Rovira, Edgardo Saucedo, Claudio Cazorla
arXiv:2608.16611v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pnictogen chalcohalide (MChX; M=Bi,Sb; Ch=S,Se; X=I,Br) solid solutions combine earth-abundant constituents, tunable band gaps (1.2-2.1 eV), and strong optical absorption, making them attractive for solar energy conversion. item.description:

👤 Jonas Hänseroth, Christian Dreßler
arXiv:2608.14899v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pretrained machine-learning interatomic potentials, so-called universal or foundation models offer an appealing starting point for atomistic simulations, but their accuracy for material-specific observables often remains limited without additional reference data (fine-tuning). Here, we systematically quantify how much first-principles data are required to convert universal models into ab initio-accurate material-specific potentials, and ask whether fine-tuning is necessarily preferable to training from scratch. We compare five universal MLIP frameworks, MACE-MP-0, SevenNet-0, GRACE-1L-OAM, MatterSim-v1-5M and ORB-v2, across seven chemically diverse systems incorporating rare and reactive events. Fine-tuning on only 10 AIMD-derived configurat…

Building on the EQL architecture, eight operators are introduced to replace standard activation functions to fit the mathematical equations in nanocrystal synthesis. item.title: 电力系统攻击检测的量子机器学习基准：评估选择先于模型决定结论
item.description:
📚 arXiv

该文在公开电力系统攻击数据上，将保真度核 SVM 和变分量子分类器与六种调优的经典模型比较，覆盖白盒、迁移、决策型黑盒和投毒攻击场景。核心结论是方法学层面的：基准结果高度受评估协议和调参选择影响，八项选择可在模型固定时改变甚至反转结论。摘要给出的例子包括数据划分方式显著改变 macro-F1，保真度核在直接攻击下鲁棒性大幅下降，错误拟合的替代模型会制造虚假的不对称性，未固定随机种子的黑盒攻击结果波动很大。

该工作提出 WF-Bench，一个用于评估神经网络波函数表达能力的基准数据集和经验标度律分析框架，通过拟合多类著名多体目标波函数来测试模型。数据集覆盖拓扑态、Wigner 晶体和超导波函数等强关联量子物质 regime，并以波函数保真度作为统一指标。作者建立可复现的目标波函数匹配协议，并在 Psiformer 与 FermiNet 上展示系统尺寸、行列式数量和模型深度等参数如何影响可表示性，为后续架构设计提供数据驱动基准。

arXiv:2608.16329v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bulk materials, as opposed to nanomaterials, require molecular dynamics (MD) simulations on a large spatial scale (~10⁹ atoms or more) to adequately capture their atomic-scale physical properties. item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Chenghao Zhang, Amke Nimmrich, Axel Gomez, Munira Khalil, Niranjan Govind
该研究提出一种用于环聚合物瞬子速率计算的机器学习框架，将高斯过程回归增强的线积分弦优化与涨落前因子的可扩展代理建模结合。通过利用代理模型的不确定性估计，瞬子路径收敛所需的力评估次数可近似不随离散珠数增加而增长。作者还引入物理启发核先验、无 Hessian 超参数优化和 GPU 加速 BBMM 来降低训练成本，并用自适应回归、选择性 Hessian 训练和三次样条插值减少显式 Hessian 计算，同时保持隧穿速率精度。

item.title: Probing Antiferromagnetic Hysteresis on Programmable Quantum Annealers
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Elijah Pelofske, Pratik Sathe, Cristiano Nisoli, Frank Barrows
arXiv:2511.17779v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Using programmable analog quantum annealing processors, we implement a sampling-based magnetic hysteresis protocol to probe the counterintuitive notion of magnetic memory in antiferromagnetic models. A key component of this protocol responsible for the hysteresis is a transverse field, which enables state transitions, while the longitudinal magnetic field sweep is done via a longitudinal control field. We observe intriguing non-monotonic magnetization, alongside full saturation and reversal of the hysteresis curve, Barkhausen-like noise, as well as emergent magnetic domains mediated by quantum fluctuations that give rise to the magnetic memory effect in antiferromagnets.

arXiv:2608.16057v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the impact of chiral damping (CD) on current-driven domain-wall (DW) dynamics in antiferromagnets (AFMs).
